entities.summary: Jamie Morgan is a former professional tennis player from Australia. Morgan never won an ATP level singles title, but finished runner-up three times. He reached the fourth round of the 1993 U.S. Open, his best performance at a Grand Slam event. He achieved a career-high singles ranking of world No. 52 in 1993. Jamie Morgan was a athletes & competitors from Sydney (b. 1971-06-08, Sydney). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
